report:
In the medial compartment, the meniscus is not torn and there is no focal chondrosis or chondral injury. 
 The lateral compartment, there is suspected small radial free edge tear at the body of the lateral meniscus. There is focal fullthickness chondral fracture at posterior weightbaring lateral femoral condyle (about intact8* intact8 cm). No subchondral edema.  
 The patellofemoral joint, there is subchondral fracture at medial patellar facet. Bone bruise at the lateral femoral condyle. There is partial tear of the medial patellofemoral ligament, at mid substance.  
 In the intercondylar notch, there is interstitial tear of the anterior cruciate ligament. The posterior cruciate ligament is intact. There is no tibial translation. 
 There is grade I ligamentous sprain of the medial collateral ligament. The posteromedial oblique ligament is intact.  
 The lateral collateral ligament complexes are intact. The popliteofibular ligament is intact. The meniscopopliteal fascicles are intact.  
 The extensor mechanism is normal.  
 Minimal amount of left knee effusion is present. There is a intact6 cm chondral fragment in the anterior intercondylar notch. The surrounding musculature is normal.  Fullthickness chondral fracture at posterior weightbaring lateral femoral condyle (about intact8* intact8 cm), left knee. (note: intact6 cm chondral fragment in the anterior intercondylar notch).

Findings:  No significant joint effusion. Tiny 5 mm x 3 mm intra-articular loose body in the intercondylar notch.. No sinister bone marrow changes.  Intact cruciate and lateral collateral ligament. Edema around the MCL, particularly proximally suggestive of a low-grade sprain.  Full-thickness radial tear of the posterior hornâ€“root junction of the medial meniscus (see image snap shot). Subsequent extrusion of the medial meniscal body from the medial joint line. Intact lateral meniscus.  Normal appearance of the pes anserine tendons, popliteus tendon, and distal biceps femoris tendon. Minor soft tissue edema deep to the distal iliotibial band the tibial insertion, of uncertain clinical significance.  Full-thickness chondral loss along the medial aspect of the medial tibial condyle with underlying bone stress change. High-grade chondral thinning also demonstrated in the medial femoral condyle. Relatively well-maintained lateral tibiofemoral compartment hyaline articular cartilage. Focal high-grade chondral thinning noted along the median patellar ridge. Medial tibiofemoral marginal osteophyte formation also demonstrated.  
Conclusion:  Low-grade sprain of the MCL. Full-thickness radial tear of the posterior horn-root junction of the medial meniscus (see image snap shot). Marked degenerative changes in the medial tibiofemoral compartment and to a lesser extent patellofemoral compartment.

MRI of right Knee with 
-Locator, SG PD FatSat, SG T2W FS, SG T1W, CO T2W FS, AX T2W FS

> Wearing of articular cartilage of right knee, especially at patellofemoral joint, with subchondral edema and spur formation, reflecting grade 4 chondromalacia, major at lateral facet.
Increased signal intensity of articular cartilage of lateral tibial plateau on F/S T2WI.
> A lobulated cystic lesion in medial popliteal fossa between the tendons of the medial head of the gastrocnemius and the semimembranosus muscles, in favor of Baker's cyst.
> The contour of ACL is in a straight line but increase signal intensity inside, in favor of grade 1 injury.
> The contour of PCL appears to be within normal, no abnormal signal intensity is noted.
> Mildly linear signal intensity in posterior horn of medial meniscus, without significant extending into the surface, in favor of  grade 2 intrasubstance signal of posterior horn of medial meniscus, maybe due to degeneration.
> Both medial & lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.
> Joint effusion and suprapatellar bursitis with suprapatellar, lateral and medial plicae; hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis.

Impressoin: 
1. Osteoarthritis of right knee , especially at patellofemoral joint with grade 4 chondromalacia.
2. Synovitis of right knee and patellar plicae.
3. Grade 2 intrasubstance signal of posterior horn of medial meniscus, maybe due to degeneration.
4. Baker's cyst.
Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation

Diz eklemi içi sıvı miktarı hafif derecede artmış. Diz eklemindeki bikompartmantal osteoartrit patellofemoral > medyal femoral tibyal eklemlerde izlenmekte olup, medyal patellar fasetteki ve medyal femoral kondilin ağırlık taşıyan yüzeyindeki kondral kalınlığın %50'sini aşan fokal incelme subkondral fibrovasküler değişiklikler ve milimetrik çaplı marjinal osteofitlerle karakterize. Lateral menisküs ön boynuzu-gövdesindeki dejenerasyon üst ve alt eklem yüzeyleri ile ilişkilenen kompleks dejeneratif yırtık ve parameniskal alandaki (menisküsü anteriyor ve lateralden çevreleyen kalınlığı 3-4 mm olan) kistlerle birlikte. Medyal menisküste ön boynuz - gövdesi ve arka boynuzu düzeyindeki dejeneratif yapı içi intensite artışı üst ve alt eklem yüzleri ile ilişkilenen esas olarak gövdesi ve arka boynuza lokalize kompleks dejeneratif yırtıklarla birlikte. İç yan bağın derin bileşenleri ödemli. Çapraz ve yan bağlar bunun dışında korunmuş. Kuadriseps yağ yastığında minimal ödem izleniyor. Semimembranozus tendonozisi insersiyon düzeyinde hafif-orta dereceli. Proksimal tibyofibuler eklem çevresinde büyüğü 1 cm çapa ulaşan gangliyon kistleri mevcut. Ekstensör mekanizma korunmuş (kuadriseps tendonu ve patellar tendon, patella ve yerleşimi, femoral troklear oluk ve patellofemoral bağlar normal). Diz eklemini çevreleyen kaslar atrofik.

Indication: Other instability, left knee; intermittent left knee pain for 4 months 
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. Edema at the superior pole of the patella. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: Mild distal quadriceps insertional tendinosis. No tendon tear. Edema in the quadriceps fat pad.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: Mild edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 13 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle. 

IMPRESSION:
1.	Mild distal quadriceps tendinosis with impingement of the quadriceps fat pad and reactive edema of the superior pole of the patella.
2.	Impingement of the superolateral Hoffa's fat pad, which can be seen in the setting of patellofemoral maltracking.

Clinical information: Lateral meniscal tear?

Technique: Unenhanced multiplanar multiphase MRI of the right knee performed at 3.0 Tesla MRI scanner.

Comparison examination: None.

Findings:
The medial and lateral meniscus are intact.

The cruciate and collateral ligaments are intact. There is moderate tendinosis of the quadriceps tendon. Otherwise extensor mechanism of the knee is unremarkable.

There are no deep cartilage defects in the medial and lateral femorotibial joint compartment. There is a mild superficial chondrosis at the lateral patellar facet (9-35) and less pronounced at the medial patellar facet. There is a focal area of subchondral bone marrow edema adjacent to the central aspect of the medial patellar facet (13-11). Otherwise there are no deep cartilage defects, no cartilage delamination, no bone marrow edema.

The joint articulations are well-maintained. There is no Baker's cyst. The infrapatellar fat pad is unremarkable.

The visualized muscle bulk is unremarkable.

Conclusion:
1. No acute meniscal or ligamentous injury.
2. Mild superficial patellar chondrosis, with a small focus full thickness cartilage denuding medial patellar facet.

SOL DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Medial menisküs diz ekleminden 4 mm hafif mediale ekstrudedir. Menisküs posterior horn ve gövde kesimde grade III dejenerasyon izlendi. Lateral menisküs normaldir.  Anterior çapraz bağda miksoid  dejenerasyona sekonder sinyal değişikliği izlendi. Arka çapraz bağ, lateral kollateral ligaman normaldir.Medial kollateral ligamende periligamentöz ödem izlenmektedir. Suprapatellar bursa ve diz eklem mesafesinde yaygın sıvı artışı izlendi. Tibiofemoral eklem medial kesimde eklem aralığında  daralma, ekleme komşu femur medial kondilde subartiküler fraktür ve kemik iliğinde ödem ile uyumlu sinyal değişikliği izlendi. Femoral ve tibial kartilajlarda incelmeler izlendi. Popliteal fossada 8.5x2 cm boyutlu baker kisti izlendi. SONUÇ  : Hafif düzeyli gonartroz, femur medial kondilde subartiküler fraktür ve medial kondili diffüz tutan kemik iliği ödemi. Medial menisküste grade III meniskopati.Anterior çapraz bağda miksoid dejenerasyon. Medial kollateral ligamende grade I sprain.Suprapatellar bursit, diz ekleminde sinovit. Popliteal fossada baker kisti.
